title: French prepositions of place
description: Where things are: sur, sous, dans, devant, derrière, entre, chez, à.

questions.question: Le chat est ___ la table. (on)
questions.explanation: Sur means on, on top of.

questions.question: Which of these say where something is? Choose all that apply.
questions.explanation: Devant is in front of and derrière is behind. Avec (with) and pour (for) don't give a place.

questions.question: Je vais ___ le médecin. (to the doctor's)
questions.explanation: Chez means at or to someone's home or practice.

questions.question: Fill in the gap: Il habite ___ Paris. (in)
questions.explanation: Use à before a city: à Paris, à Lisbonne.

questions.question: Translate: The book is between the lamp and the phone.
answer: Le livre est entre la lampe et le téléphone
